03What VESTA Manages

Every system. One intelligence.

One AI manager connecting the systems that protect, power and operate your home.

Intrusion Detection

Cameras, drones and access control work as one, now including smoke and fire detection. VESTA detects, verifies and responds to threats in seconds.

Energy Autonomy

Solar, battery or grid: VESTA automatically selects the smartest source to keep your home running and reduce energy costs.

Water Security

Water reserves and leaks are monitored in real time. VESTA keeps your available supply visible and alerts you before water becomes a problem.

Internet Backup

Fibre down? Starlink takes over automatically within seconds, keeping calls, cameras and monitoring online.

Preventive Pump Monitoring

Critical pumps are monitored continuously. VESTA detects abnormal behaviour early and alerts you before failure.

Weather Monitoring

Hyper-local weather is monitored in real time. VESTA alerts you early so your home can prepare before severe conditions arrive.
